dedupe_keys.name: high resolution topography reveals morphological changes of stromboli volcano following the july 2024 eruption

description: High-resolution topography reveals morphological changes of Stromboli volcano following the July 2024 eruption is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Riccardo Civico et al. The July 2024 eruption of Stromboli volcano has been characterised by the manifestation, at variable intensity, of the entire repertoire of volcanic events that Stromboli volcano is capable of, and is by far the one that has most changed the morphology of the crater terrace and of the Sciara del Fuoco slope in the last decades. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: GeoTIFF, Point cloud. The data are held in OpenTopography and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC BY 4.0, taken from the Data Records or Data Availability section of the paper. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
